HeatSafe helps you compare the conditions along the way, so you can make a more informed choice before stepping outside.

AB
Cooler Balanced Fastest

From address to route

Four clear steps turn live conditions into useful route choices.

01

Tell us where you are going

Enter a start and destination, or use your current location. HeatSafe looks for practical walking options between both points.

02

We check current conditions

Live temperature, feels-like conditions, humidity, wind, and air quality help describe what the walk may feel like right now.

03

Routes are compared

Each option balances estimated sun exposure and shade with distance, walking time, and nearby water access.

04

You choose what fits

Pick the coolest, balanced, or fastest route. The map and route summary make the tradeoffs easy to see before you leave.

What HeatSafe looks at

No single number tells the whole story. These signals work together to make route differences visible.

Live heat

Temperature and feels-like conditions near the route.

Estimated shade

A route-level estimate of protection from direct sun.

Air quality

Current AQI adds context when heat is not the only concern.

Water access

Known water stops along or close to the walking route.

Good to know: Shade and water access are estimates based on available map data. Conditions can change, so stay aware of your surroundings and follow local advisories.
